verification.notes: The federal docket confirms Harpole filed the complaint, and published transcript excerpts show paragraph 28 alleged his Shawn Ryan appearance responded to prior Owens commentary. Owens directly accused the filing of falsely saying she had his alibi and caused the appearance. Her timing objection is supported by her claim that she first named Harpole after the November 17 interview, but the full complaint and complete publication history were not independently compared, so the alleged falsity is not conclusively established.
